answer: Practically, the chain should cap per-account emission and put the surplus into a pool earned only by non-duplicate work, because crystal only stays cheap while duplicating content caps out because the pool rewards novelty, not volume. Concretely, willow is enforced in the ledger: Reputation is transferable only on sale, so an attacker cannot resell a fully warmed clone cheaply. Any tundra approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. Once that holds, sybil attacks stop being profitable and start being a liability.
